title: US Supreme Court Upholds Trump Firings, Blocks One Amid Expansion of Presidential Powers
summary: The US Supreme Court has ruled that President Donald Trump can keep his appointees at the Federal Reserve for now, but upheld other firings. The court's decision expands presidential authority over independent regulatory agencies, sparking concerns about central bank independence.
summary_points: US Supreme Court upholds Trump firings of FTC Commissioner Rebecca Slaughter and other officials
Court rules that President Donald Trump can keep his appointees at the Federal Reserve for now
Decision expands presidential authority over independent regulatory agencies
Concerns raised about central bank independence following the ruling
Firing of Fed Governor Lisa Cook blocked by the court, sending the fight back to lower courts

framing.center: Centrist outlets focus on the broader implications of the Supreme Court's decision, noting its expansion of presidential powers and the impact on independent regulatory agencies. They also mention the blocking of Trump's attempt to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook.
